hero.intro_text: Lorenzo Poto came to me as a client looking for a video editor. What he got was a full social media strategy that turned his Italian-speaking audience into an international community — and positioned him to build a career in Copenhagen.

pillars.title: Language transition
pillars.copy: Gradual, intentional switch from Italian to English — protecting existing followers while opening the account to an international audience. Today Lorenzo speaks and writes exclusively in English.

pillars.title: Original formats
pillars.copy: Two recurring formats designed from scratch: Kitchen Roots (technique-based educational series) and In cucina con uno sconosciuto (Lorenzo cooks live with a follower). Both drive repeat viewership and community.

pillars.title: Content balance
pillars.copy: A strategic mix of accessible everyday recipes and high-end gourmet content — balancing reach with authority. Italian ingredients meet Danish ones, reflecting exactly who Lorenzo is and where he lives.

pillars.title: Stories & engagement
pillars.copy: Stories went from nearly nonexistent to daily — with Q&As, polls, and behind-the-scenes that turn passive followers into an active, invested community.

reaction_protocol.title: Reaction Protocol
reaction_protocol.copy: Manual engagement within the first 60 minutes of every post. Stories monitored daily for DM replies and poll responses.

strategy_notes: Monthly analytics review and format adjustment
Active audience nurturing via Stories Q&A
Ongoing brand outreach and collaboration management

case_study.label: Case_study: @potuschef
case_study.title: Project.EXE
case_study.quote: Building the bridge between a chef's Italian roots and a Danish audience — one reel at a time.
case_study.copy: @potuschef is the Instagram account of Lorenzo Poto, an Italian chef based in Copenhagen. When we started working together in December 2025, he had 70K followers and a 90% Italian audience. Six months later: 113K followers, ~40% international audience, two brand collaborations (Weber and Mutti), and a sold-out pop-up dinner in Copenhagen. The strategy combined original recurring formats, a gradual language transition to English, and a daily Stories presence that turned a recipe account into a real community.

seo.seo_description: How Sara Ruffini helped @potuschef grow from 70K to 113K followers and build an international audience in six months.
